title: Mystic Portal Vision
description: A surreal painting viewed through a cracked circular purple portal dripping with orange liquid and adorned with golden keys. Inside the frame, a silhouetted figure with intricate face patterns holds a green bowl filled with blueberries and a large pink lotus flower with a lit candle. A green candle with a face and a small red boat float on dark water under a cracked moon with purple dripping substance, while rows of shadowy figures stand below.
prompt: Surreal symbolic painting seen through a cracked circular purple portal frame dripping orange wax and holding golden keys. Inside, a black silhouette of a person with heavily patterned face holds a green bowl of blueberries from which grows a giant glowing pink lotus with a lit candle. A tall green candle with a face floats on dark water beside a small red boat. A cracked white moon drips purple liquid in a twilight sky. Rows of dark stylized figures stand in the background. Psychedelic folk art style with bold outlines and vibrant contrasting colors.
